title: Το περιβάλλον στην καθημερινότητα
description: Ten standalone stories about everyday people in Greece who look after the environment at home, at school, at work and in nature.

lessons.title: Ο διαγωνισμός του σχολείου
lessons.summary: Danai's class collects bottles and paper for a school contest and wins with a new record.

lessons.title: Τίποτα δεν είναι άχρηστο
lessons.summary: Kostas's grandmother shows him how to cook with old bread and leftovers instead of throwing food away.

lessons.title: Δέντρα στην αυλή της εκκλησίας
lessons.summary: A village priest and the villagers plant trees in the bare churchyard, and two summers later the feast is held in their shade.

lessons.title: Ο συναγερμός στη μέση της νύχτας
lessons.summary: A retired colonel's alarm goes off at night, he sees two men dumping old fridges in the forest, and the police arrest them.

lessons.title: Με το ποδήλατο στη δουλειά
lessons.summary: Marina stops driving to work in Athens and starts cycling, and both her mood and her health get better.

lessons.title: Ο λύκος γύρισε στο βουνό
lessons.summary: When a wolf kills two of his sheep, a shepherd is angry, but a young scientist explains how dogs and fences can protect the flock.

lessons.title: Μια συναυλία για την παραλία
lessons.summary: A local band on Naxos gives a beach concert where the ticket is a bag of rubbish collected from the sand.

lessons.title: Ήλιος στη στέγη του εργοστασίου
lessons.summary: The owner of a small factory in Kozani takes a bank loan for solar panels and makes his business independent of the power bill.

lessons.title: Η ρομαντική μπλούζα
lessons.summary: Stella envies her friend's clothes until the friend shows her a second-hand clothing app, and Stella tries a month without new clothes.

lessons.title: Το παλιό σπίτι του παππού
lessons.summary: Instead of building a new house, Nikos's family repairs grandfather's old village house, keeping its old wooden floor.
